definitions.gloss: mattress futon; bottom futon; sleeping mat
definitions.explanation: The futon placed on the floor to sleep on, providing cushioning from the hard floor. Contrasts with {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん} (top covering).

examples.japanese: {敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}いて→敷く：00366_shiku⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I laid out the mattress futon to prepare for bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}し{入|い}れ→押し入れ：01345_oshiire⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しまう→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: In the morning, I put away the mattress futon in the closet.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厚|あつ}くて→厚い：00690_atsui⟧⟦{寝心地|ねごこち}→寝心地：07270_negokochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This mattress futon is thick and comfortable to sleep on.

notes:
{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん} is the lower layer of Japanese bedding — the padded mattress futon laid on the floor to sleep on.

Formation: ⟦{敷|し}き→敷く：00366_shiku⟧, from ⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ 'to spread out, to lay down,' + ⟦{布団|ぶとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧. Literally the 'spread-out futon,' as against the ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧ draped over the sleeper.

Collocations:
- {敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to lay out the futon
- {敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たたむ→たたむ：02073_tatamu⟧: to fold it up
- {敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: to air it

Cultural note: in traditional Japanese sleeping the {敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん} is laid directly on the ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧ at night and stowed in the ⟦{押|お}し{入|い}れ→押し入れ：01345_oshiire⟧ during the day. That daily cycle is the point: it lets one ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ serve as both bedroom and living space, which matters in small homes. Airing the futon regularly is treated as basic housekeeping rather than a chore, since bedding on the floor absorbs moisture.
